definitions.explanation: Containers (bottles, cans, boxes) and packaging (wrappers, films) used to hold or protect goods, considered collectively. Common term in recycling and waste-management regulation.

examples.japanese: {容器包装|ようきほうそう}は{分別|ぶんべつ}して{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please separate containers and packaging when disposing of them.

examples.japanese: プラスチック{製|せい}の{容器包装|ようきほうそう}はリサイクルの{対象|たいしょう}だ。
examples.english: Plastic containers and packaging are subject to recycling.

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}は{容器包装|ようきほうそう}リサイクル{法|ほう}に{基|もと}づき、{再資源化|さいしげんか}の{費用|ひよう}を{負担|ふたん}する。
examples.english: Under the Containers and Packaging Recycling Law, companies bear the cost of recycling.

notes:
Compound of {容器|ようき} (container) + {包装|ほうそう} (packaging, wrapping). A standard term in Japanese environmental law and household recycling: the {容器包装|ようきほうそう}リサイクル{法|ほう} (Containers and Packaging Recycling Law) of 1995 established producer responsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容器包装|ようきほうそう}リサイクル{法|ほう}: Containers and Packaging Recycling Law
- プラスチック{容器包装|ようきほうそう}: plastic containers and packaging
- {容器包装|ようきほうそう}{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}: containers-and-packaging waste
- {容器包装|ようきほうそう}{材|ざい}: container and packaging materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- パッケージ: package — loanword, more casual; refers to a single packaged unit
- {梱包|こんぽう}: packing, packaging — emphasizes the act of packaging for shipping
